completion_rate_definition: NUMERATOR = days in [createdDate .. asOfDate] that meet the habit (build: value >= dailyTarget; quit: no slip). DENOMINATOR = calendar days in that inclusive range. If denominator is 0, rate is 0 (never NaN/Infinity).

features.name: Creación rápida de hábitos (nombre, descripción, icono/emoji, color)
features.evidence: App Store y sitio oficial: 'Provide a name, description, icon and color and you're good to go.'

features.name: Registro de un toque para completar el día
features.evidence: Sitio oficial: one-tap logging. Reviews describen un botón de completado en cada hábito.

features.name: Grilla visual de azulejos tipo heatmap (días = celdas de color)
features.evidence: Mecanismo comercial central. 'beautiful tile-based grid charts'; GitHub-like heatmap.

features.name: Rachas actuales y récord
features.evidence: Listados: 'Get motivation from streaks' y chips de racha en detalle.

features.name: Metas de frecuencia (diario, N/semana, N/mes); días de descanso no rompen la cadena
features.evidence: Play/App Store: 3/week, 20/month, daily. Sitio: rest days do not break the chain.

features.name: Detalle de hábito con historial de mes/año de azulejos
features.evidence: Sitio: year of tiles, streak chips, calendar of every logged day. Changelog: redesigned habit detail with integrated calendar.

features.name: Calendario para agregar/quitar completados pasados
features.evidence: App Store: 'Simply tap a day to remove or add a completion.'

features.name: Archivar y restaurar hábitos
features.evidence: App Store: archive and restore from menu. Reviews: restoring archived habits is Pro.

features.name: Importar y exportar datos (portabilidad)
features.evidence: App Store: export to a file and restore later. Reviews: backup/export is Premium.

features.name: Varias densidades/modos de overview (cards, compact, checklist/list)
features.evidence: Sitio: cards, checklists, or compact views. Changelog: compact list redesigned; view switcher.

features.name: Estadísticas (tasa, días completados, rachas, tendencia mensual)
features.evidence: Sitio: completions, rates, streak records charted month by month. Reviews: detailed analytics are Premium.
features.replication_reason: Básicas en libre; avanzadas (8 semanas + mejor día) en Pro.

features.name: Personalización de color, icono/emoji y descripción por hábito
features.evidence: Sitio: hundreds of icons and 30+ colors. Store: customize dashboard colors, icons, descriptions. Emoji picker with search.

features.name: Compartir progreso como tarjeta visual
features.evidence: Sitio: turn any grid into a themed share card. Independent reviews mention share images.

features.name: Límite Free vs Pro (hábitos ilimitados, stats, widgets, export, archive restore)
features.evidence: Chile IAP: monthly, annual, lifetime Pro. Reviews: unlimited habits, widgets, stats, export are Pro. Free remains usable.
features.replication_reason: 3 hábitos libres; paywall demo sin pago fingido.

features.name: Privacidad local: sin cuenta, sin servidor, datos en el dispositivo
features.evidence: App Store: No sign-in. No servers. No cloud.

features.name: Tema claro/oscuro
features.evidence: Reviews y changelog mencionan dark mode y tema de widget independiente del sistema.

features.name: Hábitos de dejar (quit): días limpios por defecto, se marca el desliz
features.evidence: Changelog App Store: 'Quit habits are here... Every day counts as good by default; you only mark the days you slipped.'

features.name: Notas por día (press-and-hold en un día)
features.evidence: Changelog: 'Day notes are here. Press and hold any day to write down what went well...'

features.name: Reordenar hábitos (press-and-hold y arrastrar)
features.evidence: APKMirror 1.17.1 / App Store what's new: 'Press and hold a habit, then drag to reorder it'.
features.replication_reason: Subir/bajar en el tablero. Sin press-and-hold drag táctil.

features.name: Objetivo diario cuantitativo (contador) y marcas alrededor del anillo; se puede superar la meta
features.evidence: Changelog: daily target as marks around the ring; unlimited tracking (pages, minutes); go past daily targets.
features.replication_reason: Contador con marcas en el anillo; se puede superar la meta.

features.name: Inicio de semana configurable (domingo, lunes, miércoles)
features.evidence: Changelog: 'Configure the start of the week, whether it's Sunday, Monday or Wednesday.'

features.name: Recordatorios por hábito (hasta 3) y check-in diario
features.evidence: Store: reminders with notification at specified time. Changelog: up to 3 reminders per habit, daily check-in reminders.
features.replication_reason: Hasta 3 horarios y badge in-app. Sin push nativo web.

features.name: Widgets de pantalla de inicio (grilla, compact list, check-off)
features.evidence: Sitio y reviews: home screen widgets, Pro feature. Changelog: compact list widget, independent widget theme.
features.replication_reason: API nativa iOS/Android no disponible en esta ruta web.

features.name: Selector de emoji/icono con búsqueda
features.evidence: Changelog: emoji support, smart icon/emoji search. Sitio: hundreds of icons.

features.name: Selector de idioma in-app
features.evidence: What's new: pick the app language in Settings; Hindi and Korean added.

features.name: Tema de widget independiente del sistema
features.evidence: Changelog 1.15.2.

features.name: Categorías de hábitos de inicio
features.evidence: What's new mentions starter categories switching with language.

features.name: Apple Watch / Health sync
features.evidence: No evidencia pública competente en el sitio ni en los listados principales de HabitKit al momento del freeze.
